title: Private action package metadata
description: What identifies and bounds the private action package. The package itself stays under .jobloom/ with mode 0600 and is never tracked, never printed and never used as telemetry; no value-bearing example of it exists in this repository. A non-disclosure option string may appear in the package because the worker needs the target string to select it, and it discloses nothing; a demographic value may not appear anywhere.
